# Module Map — idle-base

<!-- generated by /kb-generate — last_crawl_commit: bffd7f428878374fc80f9f2b7f802b85c6958dd2 -->

266 files in the crawl, but 94 of them are `.md` — 79 under `openspec/` alone. The code is
**146 `.js` files under `src/`**. Single webpack bundle, no server. The three-way split below
(`data` → config, `engine` → logic, `components` → render) is the load-bearing convention in
the repo; violating it is the most common way a change gets rejected.

| Path | Responsibility | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src/index.js`, `src/App.js` | Mount point. `createRoot` → `GameProvider` → `AppShell`. | 8 and 13 lines. Nothing lives here. |
| `src/state/` | The store. `GameContext` (useReducer over whole game), `gameReducer` (flat switch), `actionTypes`, `initialState`. | `initialState.js` documents the null-vs-empty-slice rule. Read it before adding a slice. |
| `src/state/actions/` | 14 pure `(state, action) => state` modules, one per feature area. | Returning the *same object reference* means "refused"; callers depend on this. |
| `src/engine/` | 40 pure simulation modules. No React, no DOM, no `Date.now()`, no bare `Math.random()` (rng arrives as a defaulted parameter). | The heart of the codebase. `tickEngine.js` is the only place simulation happens. |
| `src/data/` | 35 config modules. Every tunable number, every string of player-facing prose. Zero logic. | Comments carry measured simulation results justifying values — these are the design record. |
| `src/components/` | 46 React components across 18 feature folders. Render only; decide nothing. | Each shop panel renders its engine's `listOffers()` verbatim. |
| `src/components/layout/` | `AppShell` (panel routing + act/phase gating), `HeaderStats`, `ResourceChips`, `TabNav`, `EventFeed`. | `AppShell`'s `PANELS` keys must match feature ids in `acts.js` `unlocks`. |
| `src/components/expedition/` | Act VII's six tabs — `OpsPanel`, `FabPanel`, `LaunchPanel`, `SitesPanel`, `ArtifactsPanel`, `ContractsPanel` — plus `PlaceholderPanel` and `TeardownOverlay`. | Six of these are still thin placeholders rendering copy from `data/actSevenPanels.js`; STORY-035…040 build them out. |
| `src/components/common/` | `Modal`, `Button`, `StatBar`, `CurrencyDisplay`, `ToastHost`. | `ToastHost` derives toasts from state transitions and never stores them — deliberate, see its header. |
| `src/hooks/` | `useGameTick` only: 1s TICK, 30s autosave, offline catch-up on mount, save on hide/unload. | The single timer in the app. |
| `src/persistence/` | `saveLoad.js` — localStorage read/write, version gate. | **No migration by design**: a version mismatch discards the save. |
| `src/utils/` | `formatNumber`, `randomUtils` (`pick`, `randInt`, `jitter`, `generateId`), `statUtils` (`clamp`). | Small and stable. |
| `src/styles/global.css` | The entire stylesheet, 3055 lines. Dark-green ballpark palette, plus Act VII's cold near-monochrome `--v7-*` tokens. | Organised into feature sections; **the file's last block is an `@media (max-width: 640px)` query**, so appending at EOF silently scopes a rule to mobile. |
| `docs/` | `PRD-act-seven-farm-team.md` (3734L), `PRD-incremental-odyssey.md` (710L), plus a generated HTML render and its build script. | The Act VII PRD is cited by section number (§5.x, §7.x, §8.8) throughout the new engine comments. |
| `openspec/` | Architectural decision records — 15 changes under `openspec/changes/`. | **Committed in this repo**, not untracked. **Delta specs live inside each change** (`changes/<name>/specs/<capability>/spec.md`); `openspec/specs/` and `changes/archive/` are both **empty** — nothing has been synced or archived yet. 11 of the 15 changes carry specs, across five capabilities: `expedition-state`, `progression`, `income`, `game-feedback`, `currency`. |
| `public/`, `dist/` | HTML template; webpack output (gitignored). | |
| `.github/` | GitHub Pages deploy. | |

## Engine modules by role

**Simulation core** — `tickEngine` (advance loop + `EVENT_CLOCK_CONTRIBUTORS`), `gameSim` (the
one probability model), `standings`, `schedule`, `playoffs`, `gameReplay` (beat-by-beat on-field
narration), `offlineProgress`, `pacing` (`gameSpeedMult`, the only modifier that divides a
duration).

**Rules & progression** — `modifiers` (`resolveRules` + `computeModifiers`), `progression`
(act transitions, exit predicates, initializers, `getUnlockedFeatures(act, phase)`), `prestige`
(returns to `PRESTIGE_ACT_INDEX`, **not** `FINAL_ACT_INDEX`), `narrative`.

**Act-specific** — `lotShop` (I), `wallBall` + `wallBallShop` (II), `littleLeague` (III),
`travelBall` + `sponsorships` + `bookie` (IV), `capsShop` (V+), and Act VII's six:
`colony`, `sites`, `launch`, `puzzles`, `actSevenModules`, `colonyReadout`.

**Roster & economy** — `playerFactory`, `strength` (`STAT_WEIGHTS`, `playerOverall`),
`trainingCamp`, `retirement`, `tradeDeadline`, `walkupSongs`, `wallet`, `income`, `economy`,
`concessions`, `clicker`, `powerupShop`, `identity` (team name), `feed`.

## The Act VII subsystem

`state.expedition` is a closed subsystem — nothing outside `src/engine/colony.js` may reach into
it directly, and `engine/wallet.js` is not how its four consumables are spent.

| Module | Owns |
|---|---|
| `engine/colony.js` | The slice accessor, `resolvedSites()`, the resource rate solve, `integrateColony()`, `spendResource()` (Fuel's debit path), `nextColonyThresholdClock()`. |
| `engine/sites.js` | Colonization, pad tiers, build resolution, `siteReach`, `markSiteReached`, and **the only write to `expedition.phase`**. |
| `engine/launch.js` | Offers, commit, transit, `resolveArrivals()`, the overshoot band. Takes no `rng`. |
| `engine/puzzles.js` | Puzzles, hint ladder, instruments, attempt governors. Never written from `advance()`. |
| `engine/actSevenModules.js` | The fabrication shop, in the house shop contract. |
| `engine/colonyReadout.js` | The header's boundary helper — presentation reshaping only, one rate solve. |
| `data/actSevenConfig.js` | The act's **shape**: phases, `phaseRank`, the four consumables, solve bounds, output/draw modifier key names. |
| `data/actSevenPanels.js` | The act's **surface**: six tab ids, labels and placeholder copy. |
| `data/actSeven{Modules,Sites,Launch,Puzzles,Powerups,Naming,Palette}Config.js` | Ladders, costs, transit maths, puzzle content, phase pill colours. |

Three id lists must agree and **none of the disagreements is caught by `npm run build`**:
`ACT_SEVEN_PANELS` in `data/actSevenPanels.js`, the `PANELS` map in `AppShell.js`, and the
`TABS` array in `TabNav.js` (which spreads the config list rather than restating it, so only
`PANELS` is authored by hand).

## Cross-cutting seams

Changes that touch these files affect everything; they are where parallel work collides.

- `src/state/gameReducer.js` and `actionTypes.js` — every feature adds a case here.
- `src/state/initialState.js` — every feature adds a slice.
- `src/engine/tickEngine.js` — the simulation core; **21 changes, the most-touched file in the
  repo.** Since STORY-017 a new wake boundary is an *append* to `EVENT_CLOCK_CONTRIBUTORS`
  rather than an edit to shared control flow, which removed most of the collision surface — use
  it rather than editing `findNextEventClock()`.
- `src/engine/income.js` — a new passive income source is an append to its contributor list.
- `src/engine/modifiers.js` + `src/data/modifierKeysConfig.js` — the bonus-key vocabulary.
- `src/data/acts.js` — act rules, unlocks, `unlockedBy` and pacing; nearly every feature
  registers something. 15 changes.
- `src/components/layout/AppShell.js` — 16 changes; every new tab lands here and in `TabNav.js`.
- `src/styles/global.css` — one file for the whole app, 3055 lines.
